verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official Python SDK that covers conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management, so much of the parse and extract surface is reachable from Python. Nothing in the evidence shows a TypeScript SDK, typed interfaces, SDK-level job or polling handling, or documented defaults, and the API includes endpoints not shown in the SDK. missing for 10: official TypeScript SDK, evidence of typed SDK interfaces, SDK coverage of jobs/status and of other endpoints such as segmentation, agents, and schema generation, documented sensible defaults, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official typed SDKs for Python and TypeScript cover the full API — parse, extract, jobs — with sensible defaults

citations.quote: The Datalab Python SDK provides a simple interface for document conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management.
The SDK provides a simple interface to convert documents to Markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks.
Fill PDF and image forms with structured field data using the Datalab SDK.
